Name: Milling Wear
Summary: Milling machine experiments at varied speed, feed and depth of cut that record flank wear (VB) of the insert, contributed by UC Berkeley's BEST Lab.
Publisher: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence (PCoE)
Description:
Milling Wear collects experiments run on a milling machine by UC Berkeley's BEST Lab. NASA's Prognostics Center of Excellence (PCoE) at Ames Research Center publishes it on the NASA Open Data Portal as part of its Prognostics Data Repository, a collection of donated data sets intended for building prognostic algorithms. It is cited as the Milling Data Set by A. Agogino and K. Goebel (2007).

The runs vary cutting speed, feed and depth of cut, and the wear of the milling insert, VB, is recorded. The data is distributed as a single ZIP archive from the repository. Work that uses it is asked to acknowledge both the repository and the donors, and the data is used at the user's own risk.
